# uBlock Origin / uAssets (GPLv3)

`src/vendor/ubo-youtube.js`, `src/vendor/ubo-youtube-isolated.js`, `src/vendor/ubo-youtube.css`
and `src/rules/ubo-youtube-network.json` are generated by `scripts/sync-ubo-youtube.mjs` from:

- uBlock Origin scriptlets (src/js/resources/*), Copyright (C) Raymond Hill and contributors,
  https://github.com/gorhill/uBlock (tag and commit in `src/vendor/ubo-youtube-meta.json`)
- uBlock filters (filters.txt, quick-fixes.txt, unbreak.txt), https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets
  (commit in `src/vendor/ubo-youtube-meta.json`)

Both are licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (full text: `LICENSE-uBlock-GPLv3.txt`).
The scriptlet code is copied unmodified (function bodies via `Function.prototype.toString`), and the
filters are converted with uBO's own parser and DNR converter. Distributing these files means the
GPLv3 terms apply to them; their source and the generator are in this repository.

Refresh: `deno run -A scripts/sync-ubo-youtube.mjs --uassets master --ubo <uBO release tag>`
